title: Fribourg Ultimatum Game in Schizophrenia Study
description: This dataset contains 128-channel EEG recorded during an Ultimatum Game (UG) task in patients with psychosis episodes (n=19) and healthy controls (n=24). Participants played the game in both the responder and proposer roles. Data were collected at the University of Fribourg, Switzerland, to study social decision-making in schizophrenia.
methods_description: Participants sat in a comfortable chair in a shielded room while 128-electrode EEG was recorded during the Ultimatum Game. For each role (responder and proposer), participants performed three blocks of 30 repetitions each. The study was approved by the Ethics Committee of the University of Fribourg (reference 054/13-CER-FR).
